visual_changes: Removed gemmed gold frame; new original narrow wood-paper panel rendered by 24px source/8px destination nine-slice.
24px pixel type reserved for identity, with 18px decision/14px reading/12px support roles; tools/close symbols separately sized.

limits: User has not accepted the revised visuals; functional evidence does not establish beauty.
Scene and icon source grain remains different; strict logical grid/finite palette and atlas hard alpha remain unresolved.
No player study, screen reader, physical touch or controller test.
OS reduced-motion preference switching was not tested.
No roaming world or production save; previous v1.3 evidence is historical.
